governed_agent_card.heading_html: KYE Sanctions & AML Authority Agent™
governed_agent_card.body_html: governs the consequential AML decision (block / release / escalate / file-SAR) at the action boundary. It records the contestable disposition. It holds the SAR/STR filing advisory until a named MLRO records two-person sign-off. KYE Protocol™ proves the basis; it does not run sanctions or PEP screening, run transaction-monitoring models, or decide whether a transaction is truly money-laundering.
